title: Attack Decision Graph
description: A unified, cross-vulnerability-class graph. States are conditions/capabilities an attacker has established; actions are moves attemptable from a state, each branching into one or more possible outcomes (like candidate chess moves and their resulting positions).

tier.description: Where this state sits in the general kill chain, for path-search heuristics.

value.description: Heuristic value of being in this state -- analogous to a chess position evaluation. Authored judgment, not a measured probability/impact score.

target_types.description: Applicable target.type values (web, api, mobile, cloud, network, binary, iot, other). Empty/omitted for target-agnostic capability states.

playbook_ref.description: vulnerability_playbooks.json playbook_id this state was derived from, if any.

detection_signals.description: Machine-actionable-ish hints for recognizing this state from real tool output, not a working automated classifier -- authored guidance only.

cve_refs.description: Specific CVE(s) this state represents, for technology-specific states.

technology.description: Specific technology/framework/product this state applies to, for technology-specific states (null for generic states).

is_bridge.description: True if this action crosses from one vulnerability class's territory into a shared capability/goal state -- the cross-class chaining edges.

likelihood.description: Qualitative, authored judgment -- not a measured probability.
